short.q: Write the difference between a statement and a question when reading aloud, with an example.
short.answer: A statement ends a little lower, like 电视在客厅。 A question ends a little higher, like 电视在哪儿? Every syllable keeps its tone.
short.working: 1 mark for each and 1 mark for keeping the tones.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My birthday is on 5 March."
short.answer: 我的生日是三月五号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 三 and 什么.
short.answer: 三: sān, three. 什么: shénme, what.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." and "I use my ears to hear."
short.answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door."
short.answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Read jiào, nǐ and hǎo and write each with its Chinese character and meaning.
short.answer: 叫 jiào (to be called), 你 nǐ (you), 好 hǎo (good).
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Put these words in order and translate: 在 / 电视 / 上 / 桌子.
short.answer: 电视在桌子上。 The television is on the table.
short.working: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。and pinyin optional, 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天 and 老师.
short.answer: 天: tiān, sky, day. 老师: lǎoshī, teacher.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin for 爸爸, 妈妈 and 姐姐.
short.answer: bàba, māma, jiějie.
short.working: 1 mark for each with the correct tone marks.

short.q: Give two habits of an active listener.
short.answer: Face the speaker and stay quiet; listen for key words; nod or show you are following.
short.working: 1 mark for each habit.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Good morning!"
short.answer: 早上好! zǎoshang hǎo!
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: What is the main idea of a text and what are details? Give a short example.
short.answer: The main idea is what the whole text is about, for example "my home". Details are facts that support it, for example "there is a sofa in the living room".
short.working: 1 mark for main idea, 1 mark for details, 1 mark for the example.

short.q: Write in characters the days Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
short.answer: 星期五, 星期六, 星期天.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Give two things to put in a reading journal.
short.answer: New words with pinyin and meaning, sentences you can read well, or a recording of yourself reading.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 脚 and 休息.
short.answer: 脚: jiǎo, foot. 休息: xiūxi, to rest.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Thank you!"
short.answer: 谢谢! xièxie!
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Read and translate: 星期一到星期五,去学校。
short.answer: xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, qù xuéxiào. From Monday to Friday, go to school.
short.working: 1 mark for pinyin and 2 marks for the meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today it rains."
short.answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write three actions of the body and the part that does each.
short.answer: For example 看 with the eyes, 听 with the ears, 说 with the mouth.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct pair.

short.q: Write a five-sentence weather diary for one week in Chinese with pinyin.
short.answer: 星期一,太阳很大。星期二,有云。星期三,下雨。星期四,风很大。星期五,太阳很大。 xīngqīyī, tàiyáng hěn dà. xīngqī'èr, yǒu yún. xīngqīsān, xià yǔ. xīngqīsì, fēng hěn dà. xīngqīwǔ, tàiyáng hěn dà.
short.working: 1 mark for each day with weather and pinyin.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期二 and 晚饭.
short.answer: 星期二: xīngqī'èr, Tuesday. 晚饭: wǎnfàn, dinner.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.
short.answer: I have two eyes.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 饮料, 两 and 刀.
short.answer: 饮料: yǐnliào, drinks. 两: liǎng, two (before a counting word). 刀: dāo, knife.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Describe how to make a birthday card from recycled materials. Give three steps.
short.answer: Fold recycled card or paper; decorate the front; write 祝你生日快乐! neatly inside; sign your name. Reusing materials reduces waste.
short.working: 1 mark for each step and 1 mark for the recycling reason.

short.q: Explain one similarity and one difference between naming the days in Kiswahili and Chinese.
short.answer: Similarity: both use numbers to make day names. Difference: Chinese counts from Monday (星期一 is week one) but Kiswahili counts from Saturday (Jumatatu, Monday, has tatu, three).
short.working: 2 marks for the similarity and 2 marks for the difference with an example.

short.q: Explain how nǐ hǎo is really said, and why.
short.answer: It is said like ní hǎo, because when two third tones come together, the first changes to a second tone.
short.working: 1 mark for the changed sound and 1 mark for the rule.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my older brother."
short.answer: 那是我哥哥。 nà shì wǒ gēge.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.
short.answer: There is a bed in the bedroom.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see."
short.answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Name one kind of extreme weather. Say what causes it and give one safety tip.
short.answer: For example a flood: it is caused by too much heavy rain. Stay away from fast rivers. (A drought is caused by too little rain. Save water.)
short.working: 1 mark for the event, 1 mark for the cause, 2 marks for a safety tip with a reason.

short.q: Name two fruits, one vegetable and one drink in Chinese with pinyin.
short.answer: For example 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo, 菠菜 bōcài, 茶 chá.
short.working: 1 mark for fruits, 1 mark for vegetable, 1 mark for drink.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to eat bananas."
short.answer: 我喜欢吃香蕉。 wǒ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: A picture shows a girl but the label says 儿子. Is the pair 对 or 错? Explain.
short.answer: 错 (wrong). 儿子 means son, but the picture shows a girl.
short.working: 1 mark for saying 错 and 1 mark for the reason.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom."
short.answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write a sentence about what you do on Monday and one about what you do on Sunday, with pinyin.
short.answer: For example 我星期一去学校。 wǒ xīngqīyī qù xuéxiào. 我星期天去教堂。 wǒ xīngqītiān qù jiàotáng. (Any correct sentences.)
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 月 and 太阳.
short.answer: 月: yuè, month. 太阳: tàiyáng, sun.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Explain what the part 女 tells us in 妈, 姐 and 妹.
short.answer: 女 means woman or female, so the characters are for female family members.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the link to family, 1 mark for naming the three characters.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 午饭 and 快乐.
short.answer: 午饭: wǔfàn, lunch. 快乐: kuàilè, happy.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 菠菜 and 下面.
short.answer: 菠菜: bōcài, spinach. 下面: xiàmiàn, below.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "When is your birthday?"
short.answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write a sentence asking when a friend's birthday is, and a sentence answering that your birthday is on 10 May. Include pinyin.
short.answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? 我的生日是五月十号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì wǔ yuè shí hào.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Write three things you could include in a class display and one thing to check.
short.answer: For example a labelled house plan, a birthday card and character models; check tone marks and stroke order.
short.working: 1 mark for each item and 1 mark for a check.

short.q: Explain two things that help you read a sentence at a good pace.
short.answer: Read it slowly first; join the words together; speak at natural speed; keep the tones clear; record and listen back.
short.working: 2 marks for each explained point.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 妹妹 and 米饭.
short.answer: 妹妹: mèimei, younger sister. 米饭: mǐfàn, cooked rice.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Give the Mandarin words for older brother, younger brother and younger sister, with pinyin.
short.answer: 哥哥 gēge, 弟弟 dìdi, 妹妹 mèimei.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong."
short.answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Name the three parts of a Mandarin syllable.
short.answer: An initial, a final and a tone.
short.working: 1 mark for two parts and 1 mark for all three.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 谢谢, 哭 and 星期三.
short.answer: 谢谢: xièxie, thank you. 哭: kū, to cry. 星期三: xīngqīsān, Wednesday.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write two foods from each group: fruit and meat, with pinyin.
short.answer: Fruit: 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo. Meat: 牛肉 niúròu, 鸡肉 jīròu.
short.working: 1 mark for fruit, 1 mark for meat, 1 mark for correct pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?"
short.answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme?
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Rearrange and translate: 休息 / 星期六 / 在家 / 我.
short.answer: 我星期六在家休息。 On Saturday I rest at home.
short.working: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 下雨 and 耳朵.
short.answer: 下雨: xià yǔ, it rains. 耳朵: ěrduo, ear.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Blend the syllables zhuō and zi and give the meaning.
short.answer: zhuōzi, table.
short.working: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 左边 and 房间.
short.answer: 左边: zuǒbian, left side. 房间: fángjiān, room.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 学校 and 看.
short.answer: 学校: xuéxiào, school. 看: kàn, to look, to see.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天气 and 星期六.
short.answer: 天气: tiānqì, weather. 星期六: xīngqīliù, Saturday.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister." and "Who is this?"
short.answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie. 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 儿子 and 浴室.
short.answer: 儿子: érzi, son. 浴室: yùshì, bathroom.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: What is the job of 吗 in a sentence? Give an example.
short.answer: 吗 makes a yes-or-no question, for example 电视在桌子上吗?
short.working: 1 mark for the job and 1 mark for the example.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
short.answer: The television is on the table.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write two sentences about your family with 这是, and give pinyin.
short.answer: For example 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba. 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence, 1 mark for correct pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister."
short.answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the sofa?"
short.answer: 沙发在哪儿? shāfā zài nǎr?
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Compare how Mandarin and Kiswahili name family members. Give two similarities or differences.
short.answer: Similar: both repeat a syllable in words for close family, such as baba and bàba, mama and māma. Different: Mandarin has different words for older and younger brothers and sisters, but Kiswahili uses kaka and dada for both.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Sunday, go to church."
short.answer: 星期天,去教堂。 xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: xièxie!
short.answer: Thank you!
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Goodbye!" and "Thank you!"
short.answer: 再见! zàijiàn! 谢谢! xièxie!
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Explain the job of the apostrophe in the word nǚ'ér.
short.answer: It shows where one syllable ends and the next begins, nǚ + ér.
short.working: 1 mark for each part of the explanation.

short.q: Give three steps of good imitation when learning a new word.
short.answer: Listen to the whole word, repeat it slowly, compare with the speaker and correct.
short.working: 1 mark for each step.

short.q: Write two strategies for speaking Chinese clearly.
short.answer: Listen first and copy the tone with your hand; say it slowly then faster; record yourself and compare.
short.working: 1 mark for each strategy, 1 mark for explaining how it helps.

short.q: Read the rhyme 妈妈骑马,马慢,妈妈骂马 and explain how the tone changes meaning.
short.answer: Māma qí mǎ, mǎ màn, māma mà mǎ. Mum rides a horse, the horse is slow, mum scolds the horse. The syllable ma changes meaning with the tone: mā mother, mǎ horse, mà scold.
short.working: 1 mark for the pinyin, 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for explaining the three ma words.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 花园 and 房子.
short.answer: 花园: huāyuán, garden. 房子: fángzi, house.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Explain one way each of these family members might help you: 妈妈 and 哥哥. Then say one way you help them.
short.answer: For example: mum cooks and cares for us; an older brother helps with homework; I help by washing the dishes.
short.working: 1 mark for each helper, 1 mark for how, 1 mark for your own help. Any sensible answer.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期一 and 几.
short.answer: 星期一: xīngqīyī, Monday. 几: jǐ, which number, how many.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ ài nǐ.
short.answer: I love you.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喝 and 牙.
short.answer: 喝: hē, to drink. 牙: yá, tooth.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." and "On Wednesday I go to school."
short.answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān. 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There are five people in my family."
short.answer: 我家有五口人。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is a banana."
short.answer: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I have two eyes."
short.answer: 我有两只眼睛。 wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 窗户 and 大家.
short.answer: 窗户: chuānghu, window. 大家: dàjiā, everybody.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 吃 and 前面.
short.answer: 吃: chī, to eat. 前面: qiánmiàn, in front of.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the first two strokes of 右 and the first two strokes of 左.
short.answer: 右: 撇 then 横. 左: 横 then 撇.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct stroke pair and 1 mark for the difference.

short.q: Explain how a good presenter speaks and behaves during a showcase, giving five points.
short.answer: Stands tall and smiles; looks at the audience; says each word clearly with the right tone; speaks at a steady pace and pauses; stays calm and repeats after a mistake.
short.working: 1 mark for each point.

short.q: Explain how you can guess the meaning of 咖啡 in 我喝咖啡.
short.answer: The verb 喝 means to drink, so 咖啡 must be a drink. A picture can also help.
short.working: 1 mark for the verb clue, 1 mark for the conclusion, 1 mark for another clue.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The door is on the left."
short.answer: 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: How do you write ü after j, q and x? Give one example.
short.answer: It is written as u, for example qù (to go).
short.working: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the example.

short.q: Give three tips for reading aloud clearly in Mandarin.
short.answer: Look at the whole line first; find the tones; read slowly and clearly; pause at punctuation; speak loudly enough for everyone.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Describe where three things are in a house using 在. Write the Chinese and the meaning.
short.answer: For example: 床在卧室 (the bed is in the bedroom); 冰箱在厨房 (the fridge is in the kitchen); 电视在客厅 (the television is in the living room).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for the meanings.

short.q: Say where the tone mark goes in these syllables: hǎo and liù.
short.answer: hǎo: on a. liù: on u (the second of iu).
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Give two reasons why it is important to place household items in their right places.
short.answer: It keeps the house tidy and safe, and it is easier to find things.
short.working: 1 mark for each reason.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The rain is heavy."
short.answer: 雨很大。 yǔ hěn dà.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my mother."
short.answer: 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." and "Today it rains."
short.answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà. 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my ears to hear."
short.answer: 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Saturday I rest at home."
short.answer: 我星期六在家休息。 wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Add punctuation to: 我喜欢芒果香蕉葡萄你呢
short.answer: 我喜欢芒果、香蕉、葡萄。你呢?
short.working: 1 mark for 、, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for ?.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is on the table."
short.answer: 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Decide whether each statement is 对 or 错 and explain. Text: 今天有太阳,没有雨。 Statement: 今天有雨。
short.answer: 错. The text says there is no rain (没有雨).
short.working: 1 mark for 错, 1 mark for finding 没有, 1 mark for the explanation.

short.q: Describe how to make the character 手 using local materials.
short.answer: Choose pebbles, sand, maize grains, sticks or plasticine. Lay out each stroke in the correct order: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩. Check the order with a partner.
short.working: 1 mark for the material, 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for checking.
